connector.name: Universal Connector MCP
connector.registryDescription: Security-first MCP server that connects any OpenAPI, GraphQL, gRPC or SOAP API to AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package universal-connector-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the teodormcp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UCMCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated extra hosts allowed for outbound calls (spec hosts are allowed automatically).

env.name: UCMCP_APIS_CONFIG
env.description: Path to a YAML file of APIs to preload at startup.

env.name: UCMCP_CACHE_TTL
env.description: TTL in seconds for caching read-only responses (default 60, 0 disables).

env.name: UCMCP_BLOCK_PRIVATE_IPS
env.description: Block outbound calls to private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata IPs (SSRF protection). Default true.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: Example credential convention: <API_NAME>_TOKEN / <API_NAME>_API_KEY are injected for the API loaded under that name.
